question: Which Indian broke the 200 m national record at Asian Athletics Championships 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Animesh Kujur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• During the Asian Athletics Championships 2025 held in Gumi, South Korea, **Animesh Kujur broke the 200 m national record twice in the same season**, ultimately clocking 20.32 seconds in the final to win the bronze medal.
 
• **National Record:** He shattered his own previous national record of 20.40 seconds, which he had set earlier in 2025 at the Federation Cup.
 
• **Historical Significance: **Kujur became only the second Indian male ever to win an individual medal in the 200 m event at the Asian Athletics Championships, the first since Dharambir Singh in 2015.
 
• **Other Achievement:** In the 2025 season, he also set a new national record in the 100 m sprint with a time of 10.18 seconds during a meet in Greece.
